name: research
what: An intent's Understand research: its question, the sources it read and how, the patterns worth adopting (now, later or no), a recommendation, and what only you can answer.

fields.name: question
fields.means: what it set out to learn

fields.name: sources, reads
fields.means: the reference docs it used, and how each was read

fields.name: patterns
fields.means: each with what it is, where it was seen, adopt now, later or no, and why

fields.name: recommendation
fields.means: what to adopt first, as simply as possible

written_by: the intent's thread, in its Understand step

trace.author: agent
trace.note: Written by the intent's thread; each source it read is a read event of the intent.
trace.reflection: Every new one says what it supersedes or merges among the ones of its type that hold; every change to it is an event of an AIP in the same commit (d-f960).
